visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a sage green t-shirt and glasses stands in a well-lit restaurant kitchen area. He holds a ceramic ramen bowl and speaks to a female staff member wearing a face mask. The background features stainless steel kitchen equipment and wooden interior elements. (2) A close-up shot shows yellow ramen noodles being poured from a white striped bowl into another bowl already containing broth and ingredients. The lighting is bright, highlighting the texture of the noodles. (3) The man stands outdoors on an urban street in front of a shop named '小松拉麵'. He gestures enthusiastically with one arm raised while a large yellow text overlay appears on the screen. (4) The camera focuses on a digital ordering kiosk inside the restaurant. A hand is seen interacting with the touchscreen to select menu items. (5) The man is seated at a wooden table inside the restaurant, using chopsticks to slurp a large portion of noodles from his bowl. Other customers and a refrigerator are visible in the background. (6) A hand uses a culinary blowtorch to sear slices of chashu pork in a metal tray, creating orange flames and char marks. (7) Close-up shots feature ramen toppings including a soft-boiled egg and seared chashu pork being lifted with a spoon. (8) The man continues to eat and talk to the camera, gesturing towards his bowl as he explains the food.
